title: The complication doesn't open AAPS on Wear OS 3
symptom: The complication doesn't open AAPS on Galaxy watch 4. It takes a lot of clicks to open. The issue seems to occur after complications received an update, and the UI shows a touch ripple effect but no response.
cause: The issue is caused by Android background start restrictions introduced in Android 10 (API level 29), which prevent the complication from launching the app on newer devices like the watch 4.
fix: As a workaround, change the complication tab action to MENU and then back to DEFAULT in AAPS > Settings > Complications Tab Action. This may restore functionality until the complication receives an update.
